name: Kakuriyo no Saiyaku to Utsushiyo no Ikusabime ~Kirie Hen~
original_name: 幽世ノ災厄ト現世ノ戦姫～きりえ篇～
source:
In modern times, in a certain provincial city---
Tachibana Kirie, daughter of the chief priest at Oyama Shrine, and Kurahashi Makoto, who's training as a live-in apprentice at the same shrine, find themselves facing a bizarre phenomenon.

People are suddenly losing consciousness and not waking up - an unexplained "Sleeping Sickness." Even Kirie's parents have fallen victim to this strange illness spreading through town.

By chance, Kirie and Makoto meet a black fuzzy ball that calls itself a god, who informs them the "Sleeping Sickness" is the work of beings from the hidden world - youkai, gods, and other supernatural entities.

The only ones who can oppose these beings are onmyouji with demon-quelling powers.
Whether by fate or coincidence, Kirie - who possesses these powers - hesitates but ultimately resolves to fight.

"I'm gonna beat those youkai and get rid of this 'Sleeping Sickness'!"

But to use her demon-quelling powers, she needs to... do lewd things with a man.
Kirie asks Makoto for help and prepares to get intimate.
Now armed with her full exorcism powers, Kirie stands ready to battle the beings from the world beyond human knowledge...

[Translated from [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/kakuriyo2/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
现代，某座地方城市——
大山神社宫司的女儿橘雾绘，以及同样寄宿在神社修行的仓桥真，遇上了一桩怪事。

人们突然失去意识，随后一睡不醒。这种原因不明的“昏睡病”在城里蔓延，连雾绘的父母也未能幸免。

机缘巧合下，雾绘和真遇到了一团自称神明的黑色毛球。它告诉两人，“昏睡病”是幽世之中的妖怪、神明等超自然存在所为。

能够与这些存在抗衡的，只有拥有退魔之力的阴阳师。
不知是命运使然还是纯属巧合，拥有这种力量的雾绘虽有犹豫，最终还是下定决心迎战。

“我要打倒那些妖怪，消除‘昏睡病’！”

然而，要使用退魔之力，她就必须……与男性做些羞人的事。
雾绘向真寻求帮助，准备与他亲密接触。
如今，获得完整退魔之力的雾绘，即将迎战那些超出人类认知的异界存在……
